steps: played 12 months to the end screen
scenarios.notes: Verdict: crafted game in the title, desk and debrief; template-y leaks remain (empty cards, overlapping stamps, vocabulary drift).

steps: Chose a crisis response on the desk
compared order cards with desk cards
scenarios.notes: Same orders, different card layout, labels and states (Add to this month vs Added; cost seals vs free pills). Crisis answer not visible in Map mode.

friction.happened: Card 2 sits higher than 1 and 3; the 'Cabinet pick' tag overlaps card 3 top edge and stays on card 3 after I pick card 1
YOUR PICK stamp covers the 'free' pill
STEP ACHIEVED stamp covers 'Iran's view of you'
China moves against you / Russia moves against you / ORDER National address are bare titles; lower half of page empty
HUD 'Political capital 1 left', right rail 'Political capital 1 of 4 left' with 'seals', cards use diamond cost, map menu 'Needs diamond 2, you have 1'
Different layout, 'Add to this month' vs 'Added', different cost display, forecast link text differs
Crisis answer is not shown on the map, only staff orders
First click on Desk with map menu open did nothing; a later click at the toggle worked. Mouse wheel zooms the globe while a menu is open
After each month the page lands scrolled, the scene top is cropped
'Hurts: approval 56%+' and 'works against your mission' are cryptic; 56%+ looks like a typo
BACKFIRED +4 tension on a month where the mission goal rose; 'Trump's answer: Send in special forces' reads like generated copy
5 of 6 goals met, 682/1000 but grade D and 0 stars; last month square black ('the fall') though no fall happened

friction.where: Names: IRGC, Isfahan, Fujairah, Bandar Abbas, Muscat
friction.happened: Mostly explained by the i chips and Who is who strip; Muscat and Fujairah not
Hormuz tooltip covers Myanmar label; country labels collide near the Gulf
Hostages in Afghanistan appears while the Iran war is the mission, feels random

bugs.title: Cabinet pick tag does not follow the chosen card
steps: click Hit the IRGC navy now
bugs.expected: Tag stays on the cabinet card and your pick is marked clearly
bugs.actual: Tag stays overlapping card 3, YOUR PICK stamp hides the free pill on card 1

bugs.title: Desk button ignored with map menu open
Last month tile black on a surviving run
Grade D for 682/1000 and 5 of 6 goals
bugs.actual: D, mission failed by 3 relations points

suggestions.what: One name and one icon for political capital everywhere, drop 'seals'
One order card component used by desk and map, same states and labels
Fix stamp collisions (YOUR PICK, STEP ACHIEVED, DONE) with a safe zone
Cut or fill the contentless cards in the month page
Reset scroll to the crisis scene each month; align the three response cards

delight: Title globe with the live crisis pins and the serif/sans type pairing
Debrief modal with the big stamped result number and illustrated scene
The moments timeline on the end screen

fun.reason: Choices are legible but the cabinet pick plus Approve carried me to 5 of 5 on track by month 5.

clarity.reason: Mission bar is clear; costs and Hurts labels are cryptic.

visual.reason: Real art direction and hierarchy; spoiled by overlapping stamps and uneven cards.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Stamps, scenes and verdict ceremony feel authored.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but defaults win; my choices rarely mattered.

realism.reason: Plausible headlines; random hostages crisis and Trump's answer wording break it.

replay.reason: Other flashpoints tempting, but I saw the loop in 3 months.

recommend.reason: Closer to a crafted game than a dashboard, but I would wait for vocabulary and parity fixes.

quit_point: Month 2, desk after switching to the map: map and desk order cards behave differently and the Desk button did not respond. I would have stopped there and posted my notes.
verbatim: It looks like someone cared, then I find three names for the same currency and a stamp sitting on top of the text. Fix the small stuff and I would show it to the studio.
